issues.message: 1 of 2 impedance-carrying wire ports opt into reference_plane_cells — off-diagonal S entries involving a non-opted port SILENTLY stay on the legacy port-cell path (only pairs where BOTH ports opt in use the plane waves). Opt in every wire port of the S-matrix, or none.

2 conductor sheet dimension(s) are solved more than 1% off their drawn size (worst 2 listed): thin_conductor[0] 'thin_conductor[0]' y: drawn 5mm, nodes cover 5mm, solved as 5.3mm (+6.00%); thin_conductor[0] 'thin_conductor[0]' x: drawn 17mm, nodes cover 17mm, solved as 17.3mm (+1.76%). OBSERVED: the node span the sheet's realized footprint covers on this run's grid, plus 0.30 of the adjacent cell at each free in-plane edge -- a PEC sheet's edge is solved that far beyond its last node (measured on this solver, both polarizations; a flat wall has no such offset). REMEDY: build the in-plane profiles with rfx.mesh_edges.edge_aware_profiles(domain, dx, sheets=[...], solids=[...]) and pass them as Simulation(dx_profile=..., dy_profile=...); a node ON the edge is not the fix. STALE IF: the footprint's node span on the run's node coordinates does not reproduce the printed numbers.
